# Third-Party Assets

No third-party assets are currently included.

Every imported asset must add an entry containing:

- asset or pack name;
- creator;
- source URL;
- exact license and version;
- required attribution text;
- local file paths; and
- modifications made.

Prefer CC0 assets during prototyping. Do not commit assets whose custom license
forbids redistribution, even if they are free to use in a compiled game.

## Candidate Sources

These sources have not yet been added or approved for a final visual style:

| Source | Potential use | License notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Kenney](https://kenney.nl/assets) | UI, effects, audio, and placeholder art | CC0; attribution optional |
| [0x72 DungeonTileset II](https://0x72.itch.io/dungeontileset-ii) | Coherent 16x16 dungeon prototype | CC0 |
| [Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup tiles](https://github.com/crawl/tiles) | Broad fantasy creatures, items, and effects | Use only files identified as CC0 |
| [Game-icons.net](https://game-icons.net/) | Skills and status icons | CC BY 3.0; author attribution required |
| [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/) | Supplemental art and audio | License varies per item; verify each asset |
| [Godot demo projects](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects) | Implementation references and placeholders | MIT repository; verify bundled notices |

Avoid assets marked noncommercial so the project retains the option of a
commercial release later. Assets under custom licenses that prohibit raw-file
redistribution must be downloaded separately and cannot live in this public
repository.
